verdict.rationale: Render supports several event-driven automations — auto-deploy on push (render-docs-1), load-based autoscaling (render-docs-11), and configurable webhooks that notify external systems on service events like deploy start or scale-down (render-docs-31) — which together approximate rule-based triggers. However, there's no first-class 'rules engine' UI for defining custom conditional automations beyond these built-in triggers and webhook notifications. Missing for 10: a dedicated rules/automation builder, support for custom conditional logic (not just fixed event types), and independent evidence of users building automation workflows on these triggers.
